title: Toward Machine Learning with the Unit as a Primitive: Learning from Unit-Linked Events
abstract: arXiv:2608.25118v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning is usually formalized through samples, while the persistent individual to which multiple observed or possible events refer often remains implicit. We propose the \emph{unit} as an explicit primitive at the level of task semantics. A learning task first declares a population of persistent referents and a sameness criterion; the realized value $u$ denotes the selected referent. Supervised learning is the main formal specialization. Its semantic object is a family of unit-conditioned response laws. Homogeneity is the special case in which those laws coincide; a sample-only conditional is silent as to whether the world is homogeneous or the observed law is only the marginal of a heterogeneous family. What is learned from data is a pair $(T_\phi,R_\theta)$: a tokenizer that produces a contextual unit token and one shared response-law form that reads it. The structured class takes that form to be a simple relation in the token

translated_title: 以单元为原语的机器学习：从单元关联事件中学习
translated_abstract: 机器学习通常通过样本进行形式化，而多个观测或可能事件所指向的持久个体往往保持隐式。我们提出将“单元”作为任务语义层面的显式原语。学习任务首先声明一个持久指称对象群体及一个同一性标准；实现值 \(u\) 表示所选指称对象。监督学习是主要的形式化特例。其语义对象是单元条件响应定律族。同质性是这些定律重合的特例；仅基于样本的条件对于世界是同质的还是观测定律仅是异质性家族的边际情况保持沉默。从数据中学到的是一个对 \((T_\phi,R_\theta)\)：一个生成上下文单元令牌的分词器，以及一个读取该令牌的共享响应定律形式。结构化类将该形式视为令牌中的简单关系。
tldr: 本文提出将“单元”作为机器学习任务语义中的显式原语，用于处理单元关联事件，并引入一种由分词器和共享响应定律组成的结构化学习框架，以解决样本条件无法区分同质性与异质性的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the "unit" as an explicit primitive in task semantics for machine learning from unit-linked events, introducing a structured framework of a tokenizer and a shared response-law form to address the silence of sample-only conditionals on homogeneity versus heterogeneity.
